skipped.reason: Prefetch is on the placebo list (slower boot and launches until it rebuilds)
native action delivery-optimization is implemented by rules_windows (maintenance)
component store cleanup is DISM territory (maintenance module), never ResetBase
MSI patch baseline: needed to uninstall updates
rollback of the previous Windows; cleanmgr territory, not a cache
holds Amcache.hve (application compatibility), not a cache
rules_windows ships its own docker builder prune rule
fileMatch.skipIfChildExists has no equivalent in the Rule shape
wipes the shader cache of installed games too; rules_windows offers only uninstalled games
history/cookie databases: BleachBit and rules_windows own browser privacy
redistributable folders live inside game folders; never game files
event logs and Recycle Bin are not cleanup targets here
